name: AeroGuard: Aerodynamic Protective Cones
description: Designed for airborne applications, the AeroGuard series provides aerodynamic efficiency and physical protection for the MEMS sensor arrays. Manufactured from ultra-lightweight Carbon Fiber, these cones minimize drag on fixed-wing drones while allowing sound waves to penetrate freely.

name: SKHY Light Edge AI & RF Fusion Node
description: Compact edge compute for RF/Acoustic classification. Heterogeneous Compute architecture (NVIDIA Orin Nano 8GB + USRP E310) powered by a 12V DC common power port with an internal voltage regulator. Features MIMO Mesh, Split-Frequency, Frequency Hopping, and Spectrum Awareness. All non-power I/O pins for the E310 and Orin Nano remain exposed for custom interfacing.

name: AJGPS 602 Eight-channel GNSS Anti-Jamming System
description: Compact low-power anti-interference processing with 8 channels.

name: AJGPS 601 Eight-channel GNSS Anti-Jamming System
description: Advanced 8-element controlled reception pattern antenna (CRPA) system. Employs 7-channel null-steering to simultaneously track and neutralize up to six broadband interference sources, ensuring high-resilience PNT (Position, Navigation, and Timing) data in highly contested electronic warfare (EW) environments.

name: AJGPS 303 Four-channel GNSS Anti-Jamming System
description: Next-generation 4-channel anti-jamming CRPA system. Expands upon the 302 architecture by adding dedicated null-steering for GALILEO E1 alongside GPS L1/L2/L5, providing critical multi-constellation redundancy for international NDI (Non-Developmental Item) deployments.

name: AJGPS 301 Four-channel GNSS Anti-Jamming System
description: High-performance 4-channel GNSS anti-interference system. Utilizes Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna (CRPA) technology to detect and nullify up to three broadband interference sources. Ensures high-resilience PNT (Position, Navigation, and Timing) data for critical mission UAVs in contested RF environments.

name: AJGPS 302 Four-channel GNSS Anti-Jamming System
description: 4-channel GNSS anti-jamming antenna system. Provides critical resilience against RF interference, intentional jamming, and spoofing for mission-critical UAVs and ground vehicles.

name: SKHY-MOBISENSE: Multi-Spectral Mobile Station
description: Fusion of Acoustic and RF Intelligence on a Rapid-Deploy Mast.

name: SKHY-A16: Long-Range Acoustic Array
description: 16-channel microphone array for advanced acoustic drone detection and high-value asset protection. Features extreme sensitivity and advanced filtering for high-noise environments.

name: SKHY-A7: Compact Acoustic Sentinel
description: The lightweight standard for autonomous aerial & ground detection.

name: SKHY Fiber-Optic Tethered Drone
description:
Secure, jam-proof observation drone via fiber-optic tether.

The SKHY Fiber-Optic Drone provides completely jam-proof, secure video and telemetry streaming through an ultra-lightweight fiber micro-tether. It is immune to RF interference, jamming, and spoofing, making it the ultimate tool for secure perimeter defense.

**Hardware & Payload**
Data Link: Unjammable Fiber-Optic Micro Tether
Range: Up to 20km (Configurable)
Visual: 30x Optical Zoom / 2K Resolution
Thermal: 640 x 512 Vox / 19mm Lens
LRF: 1500m Laser Range Finder
Weight: 3.8kg (Platform Only)

name: SKHY Surveyor Drone
description:
VTOL long-range scout with acoustic & RF intelligence.

The SKHY Surveyor is a high-endurance VTOL (Vertical Take-Off and Landing) platform designed for persistent ISR. It integrates multi-modal sensing including an 8-microphone acoustic array and RF signal intelligence to detect and track threats in complex environments.

**Performance & Endurance**
Endurance: 150 - 180 Minutes
Design: VTOL Fixed-Wing Hybrid
Intelligence: 8-Mic Acoustic Array + RF Sensing
Deployment: Rapid Field Assembly

name: SKHY Fiber-Optic Tethered Drone
description: The SKHY Fiber-Optic Drone provides completely jam-proof, secure video and telemetry streaming through an ultra-lightweight fiber-optic tether. Perfect for high-EW (Electronic Warfare) environments and secure perimeter observation.

name: AB40 MANET Radio (High-Altitude Backbone)
description: High-power airborne MANET node designed for high-altitude pseudo-satellites (HAPS) or tethered aerostats. Provides a 100-200 km line-of-sight (LOS) backbone relay, seamlessly linking decentralized tactical swarm clusters back to localized command centers.

name: AB20 MANET Radio (Medium ISR – Active Cooling)
description: High-throughput mid-tier MANET radio designed for Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) platforms. Features active thermal management for continuous 50–100 km LOS air-to-ground video streaming. Optimized as an edge-compute relay for the Vidur AI platform.

name: HH20 MANET Dual-Band Ground User
description: Ruggedized dual-band handheld MANET node for dismounted operators. Provides seamless integration with ATAK (Android Team Awareness Kit) and tactical swarm feeds. Capable of 10–30 km in open ground and 1–5 km in dense urban/obstructed environments.

name: VC20 MANET Ground Command Unit (Four-band Antennas)
description: Primary tactical ground command node. Utilizes a quad-sector antenna array for extreme NLOS penetration and 100+ km ground-to-air tracking. Acts as the central synchronization hub for distributed MANET clusters and command-level AI orchestration.

name: AB2 MANET Radio (Tactical Swarm)
description: Ultra-low SWaP-C (Size, Weight, Power, and Cost) MANET node specifically engineered for Project Swarn architectures. Enables dynamic, self-healing tactical mesh networking for drone swarms with a 20–50 km LOS capability.

name: SKHY-MOBISENSE: Multi-Spectral Mobile Station
description:
Fusion of Acoustic and RF Intelligence on a Rapid-Deploy Mast.

The SKHY-MOBISENSE is a turnkey solution for perimeter defense. It combines the precision of the SKHY-7 acoustic sensor with the electromagnetic spectrum awareness of dual Log-Periodic Dipole Array (LPDA) antennas. Mounted on a 5m telescopic mast, this system correlates sound and radio signals to virtually eliminate false positives.

**System Configuration**
Acoustic Node: 1x SKHY-7 MEMS Sensor
RF Node: 2x Directional LPDA Antennas
Protection: Carbon Fiber Conical Hat (Acoustically transparent, weather resistant)
Mount: 5-meter Telescopic Mast

**RF Antenna Specifications**
Frequency Range: 400MHz – 8GHz
Dimensions: 27 cm x 23 cm
Input Resistance: 50Ω
Noise Level: -89dBm & Under
VSWR: ~2 (1GHz-8GHz) / ~4 (400MHz-1GHz)
Antenna Weight: 370g per unit
Total Head Unit Weight (Est): ~1.2 kg

**Includes**
- Skhy Light Edge AI Device
- IP67 Screen console
- Integration and Deployment (for minimum 10 vehicles)
- *Mast not included

**Demo**
Watch SKHY Threat Awareness Demo

name: SKHY-A16: Long-Range Acoustic Array
description:
Maximum sensitivity for high-value asset protection.

The SKHY-16 significantly expands the acoustic aperture using a 16-MEMS array. With a larger 165mm aluminum circumference, this unit captures lower frequency signatures more effectively, providing extended warning times for high-speed threats like jet aircraft and get directional heading of the object.

**Key Features**
- Extended Horizon: Detects jet take-offs (from drones) from up to 350km away, providing strategic early warning.
- High-Fidelity Audio: 16-channel input allows for superior noise cancellation and direction-of-arrival (DoA) accuracy.
- Heavy-Duty Shielding: optimized for stationary ground installations or heavy-lift drone platforms.

**Technical Specifications**
Sensor Array: 16x MEMS Microphones
Detection Range (Autonomous Drones): Up to 4 km
Detection Range (Helicopters): Up to 35 km
Detection Range (Jet Planes, Pre-burn/Take-off): Up to 250km
Dimensions: 170mm (L) x 170mm (W) x ~100mm (H)
Construction: 165mm Diameter Aluminum Housing, Reinforced 3D Printed Base
Power Consumption: 12V @ 3A–4A
Estimated Weight: ~650g
